The pages state one exercise per interest year in the last two interest years, but do not provide a separate annual_exercise_limit term beyond that rule.

The put clause states a continuous 30 trading day observation period, but the schema's put.observation_window is unresolved because the same clause is already captured under required_days and no separate observation window term is stated.

The put clause states 70% of the current conversion price, but the schema's put.trigger_ratio is unresolved because the same clause is already captured under put_price_rule and no separate trigger ratio term is stated.

The put clause states a continuous 30 trading day observation period, but the schema's put.observation_window is unresolved because the same clause is already captured under required_days and no separate observation window term is stated.

The put clause states 70% of the current conversion price, but the schema's put.trigger_ratio is unresolved because the same clause is already captured under put_price_rule and no separate trigger ratio term is stated.
The pages provide the accrued interest formula for redemption, but do not state a separate accrued interest redemption rule term.
The pages state the maturity redemption price as 115% of face value including final interest, but do not state a separate maturity redemption price rule term.
The pages state redemption within five trading days after maturity, but do not state a separate maturity redemption window days term.

The redemption clause states a continuous 30 trading day observation period, but the schema's redemption.observation_window is unresolved because the same clause is already captured under required_days and no separate observation window term is stated.

The redemption clause states 130% of the current conversion price, but the schema's redemption.trigger_ratio is unresolved because the same clause is already captured under outstanding_principal_threshold and no separate trigger ratio term is stated.
